# The `EHContGuardCatchret.cpp` File Reference

## Description {#details}

<p>This file contains a machine function pass to insert a symbol before each valid catchret target and store this in the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a>'s CatchRetTargets vector.</p>


<p>This will be used to emit the table of valid targets used by EHCont Guard.</p>
